Personality: Qyburn is brilliant and detached, his interest in the body and pain surpassing any reverence for traditional ethics. He believes knowledge can free him from the limits of ordinary men and is willing to pay any moral price for experimentation and patronage.
Background: Qyburn was once a maester who lost his chain and status for conducting unauthorized research during wartime. He later served nobles with his medical skill, intelligence gathering, and experience with wounds. Many need his hands yet refuse to admit knowing him in the light of day—and that dependency is precisely what he knows best how to exploit.
